reserveReview.rationale: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at zkSync Era block 71379594: the verified Lockdrop portal source names treasuryAddress as the stablecoin deposit destination, and treasuryAddress() returned 0xa5ad8953de51ced330e788dddde19a5f96cac082. That treasury held 0 USDC and 0 USDC.e (and 53,236.81 zkUSD) against a totalSupply of 1,179,099.482755 zkUSD; explorer token-transfer history shows the treasury's USDC.e was moved out in tranches through 2024-10-16 to addresses no current source identifies. No reserve asset, collateral pool, counterparty, coverage ratio, custody arrangement, or assurance process is established by a current primary source, and docs.goal3.xyz and goal3.xyz still do not resolve in DNS, so the full backing is retained as unknown without carrying forward the archived documentation's unsupported positive premise.
